Response:
## Customer Support Dashboard Overview

A compact dashboard for this store should show **workload**, **resolution efficiency**, and **customer satisfaction** together so trends are easy to spot month by month. The dataset suggests improving performance overall, with one response-time dip in March.

## Recommended Charts and Key Metrics

Chart 1: **Support Volume vs Resolutions**
- Type: Dual-line chart
- X-axis: Month
- Y-axis: Ticket count
- Series: Tickets_Opened, Tickets_Resolved
- Why it helps: Shows whether the team is keeping up with incoming demand.

Chart 2: **Resolution Rate Trend**
- Type: Line chart or bar chart
- X-axis: Month
- Y-axis: Resolution rate %
- Formula: Tickets_Resolved / Tickets_Opened
- Why it helps: Highlights operational efficiency and backlog risk.

Chart 3: **Response Time and CSAT Trend**
- Type: Two-line chart with dual axis
- X-axis: Month
- Y-axis left: Avg_Response_Min
- Y-axis right: CSAT_5
- Why it helps: Connects faster replies with better customer satisfaction.

## Dashboard Data View

| Month | Tickets Opened | Tickets Resolved | Resolution Rate | Avg Response (Min) | CSAT / 5 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2025-01 | 420 | 390 | 92.9% | 18 | 4.2 |
| 2025-02 | 460 | 440 | 95.7% | 16 | 4.4 |
| 2025-03 | 510 | 470 | 92.2% | 21 | 4.1 |
| 2025-04 | 495 | 480 | 97.0% | 15 | 4.5 |
| 2025-05 | 530 | 500 | 94.3% | 14 | 4.6 |

## Top Insights

- **Workload is rising steadily**: tickets opened increased from **420** in January to **530** in May, so staffing or automation may need to scale.
- **Operational performance improved overall**: resolution rate peaked at **97.0% in April**, showing the team can clear most incoming tickets.
- **Faster responses align with better satisfaction**: response time dropped from **21 min in March** to **14 min in May**, while CSAT rose from **4.1** to **4.6**.

## Quick Actions

- Dataset calculations: derived from the values you provided
- Chart design reference: https://www.tableau.com/learn/articles/data-visualization
- KPI guidance for support teams: https://www.zendesk.com/blog/customer-service-kpis/
